Aurelia Torquata.relic: bronze censer, with a smoky-glass central inset
Aurelia Torquata.hook: She keeps every vow she has kept as an iron token, and the pouch grows heavy.

Cassia Tuca.relic: violet omen reliquary, with a smoky-glass central inset
Cassia Tuca.hook: She reads the ash of burned heretics and has never once read mercy there.

Firmina Corbulo.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, with a smoky-glass central inset
Firmina Corbulo.hook: She carried the Vigil's reliquary out of a fallen fort on her back.

Eugenia Laenas.relic: fractured dawn icon, with a smoky-glass central inset
Eugenia Laenas.hook: She stood the dawn watch alone for forty days after her Sisters fell.

Quinta Scapula.relic: interrogation seal, encased in dark iron lattice
Quinta Scapula.hook: She questions sentries at the gate, and the honest ones still sweat.

Faustina Ambusta.relic: violet omen reliquary, worn smooth around a single amber light
Faustina Ambusta.hook: She foretold the burning of her own city and was not believed.

Benigna Medullina.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, worn smooth around a single amber light
Benigna Medullina.hook: She shields the dying so they may finish their last prayer.

Justa Vindex.relic: silver dueling gauntlet, worn smooth around a single amber light
Justa Vindex.hook: She duels only the guilty, and has never lacked an opponent.

Restituta Cossa.relic: fractured dawn icon, worn smooth around a single amber light
Restituta Cossa.hook: She walked out of the pyre that was lit for her, and forgave no one.

Tertia Macra.relic: vow collar, hung from three red wax-sealed chains
Tertia Macra.hook: She whips herself for every patient she could not save.

Tacita Lamia.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Tacita Lamia.hook: She has sealed a confession inside her reliquary that no one may hear.

Octavia Atrata.relic: concealed ritual dagger hilt, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Octavia Atrata.hook: She wears the veil so the condemned cannot plead with her face.

Sulpicia Sacerdos.relic: sealed silver chalice, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Sulpicia Sacerdos.hook: She tastes every cup she offers, in case the heretics poisoned it.

Livia Merula.relic: small cracked singing bell, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Livia Merula.hook: She sings the names of the judged so the Lord can find them.

Sexta Pollio.relic: vow collar, with a smoky-glass central inset
Sexta Pollio.hook: She confesses each blow she lands, then lands another.

Postuma Vespillo.relic: oath-bound sword hilt, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Postuma Vespillo.hook: She guards a tomb whose door she was ordered never to open.

Ursula Messalla.relic: silver dueling gauntlet, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Ursula Messalla.hook: She duels the dead who rise in the ossuary, one at a time, every night.

Januaria Tuditana.relic: funerary key, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Januaria Tuditana.hook: She has stood at the same grave so long the moss climbs her greaves.

Decima Cursor.relic: vow collar, worn smooth around a single amber light
Decima Cursor.hook: She buried her whole novitiate with her own hands.

Mustiola Naso.relic: lowered ivory beak mask, worn smooth around a single amber light
Mustiola Naso.hook: She hears the plague-dead confess, and keeps their sins from spreading.

Caecilia Dolabella.relic: silver dueling gauntlet, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Caecilia Dolabella.hook: She duels to the rhythm of a hymn only the Choir can hear.

Candida Vala.relic: funerary key, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Candida Vala.hook: She lit ten thousand candles for the dead and remembers every name.

Agatha Nerva.relic: fractured dawn icon, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Agatha Nerva.hook: She sings at dawn over the bodies, so they know the night is over.

Flavia Bassa.relic: vow collar, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Flavia Bassa.hook: She keeps time for the Choir with the flail she scourges herself with.

Prima Tubero.relic: bronze censer, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Prima Tubero.hook: She tends the censers of a chapel that still receives anonymous candles.

Perpetua Aspera.relic: funerary key, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Perpetua Aspera.hook: She wears a crown of briar under her helm and never takes it off.

Blandina Bestia.relic: fractured dawn icon, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Blandina Bestia.hook: She offers her own blood at every altar before she asks for anything.

Thecla Lentula.relic: small cracked singing bell, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Thecla Lentula.hook: She sings through the thorns in her throat, and the dead go quiet.

Sabina Fimbria.relic: interrogation seal, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Sabina Fimbria.hook: She hunts the fraud who wore her Order's sacred vestments.

Nona Silana.relic: violet omen reliquary, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Nona Silana.hook: She reads omens in the scars on her own arms.

Marina Gurges.relic: fractured dawn icon, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Marina Gurges.hook: She drowned at her vows and was pulled from the font still praying.

Severa Ahala.relic: broken execution bell, encased in dark iron lattice
Severa Ahala.hook: She rings the drowned bell once for every heretic she beheads.

Junia Hypsaea.relic: interrogation seal, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Junia Hypsaea.hook: She interrogates the drowned, and the drowned answer.

Aquilia Lepida.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Aquilia Lepida.hook: She hauled her Order's reliquary up from a flooded crypt.

Nympha Sisenna.relic: violet omen reliquary, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Nympha Sisenna.hook: She hears the tide counting down the hours of the damned.

Veronica Augurina.relic: sunken saint medallion, hung from three red wax-sealed chains
Veronica Augurina.hook: She sees the truth in still water and has stopped looking at her own reflection.

Lucretia Piso.relic: iron rose reliquary, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Lucretia Piso.hook: She tends a garden of thorns grown from the graves of liars.

Digna Mancina.relic: interrogation seal, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Digna Mancina.hook: She breaks mirrors to see which ones bleed.

Hortensia Luscina.relic: lowered ivory beak mask, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Hortensia Luscina.hook: She takes plague confessions through a pane of cracked glass.

Speciosa Pictor.relic: bronze censer, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Speciosa Pictor.hook: She paints saints on glass with the ash of heretics.

Peregrina Rufa.relic: interrogation seal, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Peregrina Rufa.hook: She walked home from a pilgrimage that returned no one else.

Silvia Pulchra.relic: small cracked singing bell, encased in dark iron lattice
Silvia Pulchra.hook: She sings marching hymns on roads that lead only to graves.

Rutila Crassa.relic: vow collar, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Rutila Crassa.hook: She has worn out eleven pairs of boots on the red road.

Germana Longa.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Germana Longa.hook: She carries a reliquary from shrine to shrine and never sleeps under a roof.

Aula Philo.relic: ivory-bound miniature codex, encased in dark iron lattice
Aula Philo.hook: She records every pilgrim who falls, so the road remembers them.

Maxima Cornicen.relic: vow collar, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Maxima Cornicen.hook: She hears a bell that no one else admits is ringing.

Terentia Noctua.relic: interrogation seal, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Terentia Noctua.hook: She counts the tolls of the Hollow Bell and knows who each one is for.

Claudia Cicurina.relic: violet omen reliquary, encased in dark iron lattice
Claudia Cicurina.hook: She reads the ash that falls when the great bell rings.

Laeta Stolo.relic: miniature candlelit shrine, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Laeta Stolo.hook: She cast a bell from the armour of fallen Sisters.

Felicitas Vulso.relic: fractured dawn icon, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Felicitas Vulso.hook: She rings the dawn bell each morning, even in a besieged town.

Valeria Falco.relic: compact crossbow stock beside shoulder, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Valeria Falco.hook: She has never missed a shot from the walls, and never fired twice.

Bibiana Strabo.relic: compact crossbow stock beside shoulder, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Bibiana Strabo.hook: She ends the suffering of the damned from a mercy's distance.

Tullia Capito.relic: compact crossbow stock beside shoulder, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Tullia Capito.hook: She delivers the Tribunal's verdict by bolt when the guilty flee.

Aemilia Nasica.relic: compact crossbow stock beside shoulder, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Aemilia Nasica.hook: She watches the graveyard from the bell tower with a loaded crossbow.

Canidia Ravilla.relic: covered witchfire brazier, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Canidia Ravilla.hook: She burns the books the Tribunal condemns, and memorises them first.

Furia Cethega.relic: covered witchfire brazier, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Furia Cethega.hook: She lights her witchfire from her own blood.

Benedicta Pansa.relic: iron exorcism lantern, worn smooth around a single amber light
Benedicta Pansa.hook: She leads lost souls out of the crypts by lantern light.

Lucilla Thurina.relic: iron exorcism lantern, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Lucilla Thurina.hook: She exorcises to the tune of the Choir, and the spirits flee in time.

Domitilla Frugi.relic: iron rose reliquary, with a smoky-glass central inset
Domitilla Frugi.hook: She keeps the gate garden of the Vigil, every thorn a sentry.

Fabiola Merenda.relic: iron rose reliquary, worn smooth around a single amber light
Fabiola Merenda.hook: She grows healing herbs among the thorns and bleeds to harvest them.

Petronilla Cotta.relic: iron rose reliquary, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Petronilla Cotta.hook: She plants a briar on every grave so the dead stay put.

Lollia Casca.relic: concealed ritual dagger hilt, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Lollia Casca.hook: She cuts her vows into her own palm, one line at a time.

Cornelia Mela.relic: concealed ritual dagger hilt, encased in dark iron lattice
Cornelia Mela.hook: She strikes from the shadows of the pilgrim road.

Drusilla Laeca.relic: concealed ritual dagger hilt, hung from three red wax-sealed chains
Drusilla Laeca.hook: She strikes only between the tolls of the bell.

Concordia Esquilina.relic: small mirrored judgment icon, encased in dark iron lattice
Concordia Esquilina.hook: She judges pilgrims by their reflections at every well.

Volumnia Licina.relic: ivory-bound miniature codex, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Volumnia Licina.hook: She catalogues the bones of saints that were never canonised.

Antonia Libo.relic: folded battle pennant, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Antonia Libo.hook: She carries the Watch's banner into every crypt, and out again.

Fonteia Paeta.relic: folded battle pennant, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Fonteia Paeta.hook: She raised her Order's banner from the bottom of a lake.

Vitalia Sicula.relic: sealed silver chalice, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Vitalia Sicula.hook: She mixes her cures with holy water and powdered glass.

Honorata Gemella.relic: sealed silver chalice, encased in dark iron lattice
Honorata Gemella.hook: She carries a chalice from the first pilgrimage and lets no one drink.

Licinia Glabrio.relic: resonating metal throat icon, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Licinia Glabrio.hook: She sings the drowned hymn in iron armour, and does not sink.

Vibia Trio.relic: bronze censer, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Vibia Trio.hook: She swings her censer through the briars and bleeds for the incense.

Septima Carbo.relic: oath-bound sword hilt, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Septima Carbo.hook: She protects travellers while quietly questioning her own hierarchy.

Constantia Camerina.relic: funerary key, with a smoky-glass central inset
Constantia Camerina.hook: She keeps the relic of a mentor whose last order she refused.

Hilaria Rulla.relic: resonating metal throat icon, set in a square weathered bronze housing
Hilaria Rulla.hook: She leads the Choir's battle hymn and has never once been out of tune.

Verginia Imperiosa.relic: oath-bound sword hilt, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Verginia Imperiosa.hook: She took the Tribunal's oath on a blade, and the blade agreed.

Rubria Corvina.relic: sealed crimson oath vial, encased in dark iron lattice
Rubria Corvina.hook: She signed her oath in blood and has bled for it every day since.

Clara Capitolina.relic: small mirrored judgment icon, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Clara Capitolina.hook: She judges the Choir's singers by the mirrors they cannot see.

Emerentiana Scaura.relic: sealed silver chalice, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Emerentiana Scaura.hook: She brings the last cup to the dying, and the dead thank her.

Pelagia Murena.relic: sunken saint medallion, encased in dark iron lattice
Pelagia Murena.hook: She saw the end of the world in a font and is still waiting for it.

Marcia Scaevola.relic: silver dueling gauntlet, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Marcia Scaevola.hook: She duels in a veil, and none who saw her face have spoken since.

Scholastica Varro.relic: ivory-bound miniature codex, inlaid with a small bone-white devotional figure
Scholastica Varro.hook: She keeps the Vigil's roll of the fallen, written in their own ash.

Galla Fusca.relic: covered witchfire brazier, encased in dark iron lattice
Galla Fusca.hook: She lights her pyres with a torch carried from the first martyr's flame.

Placidia Sura.relic: sealed silver chalice, bound in frayed crimson vow ribbons
Placidia Sura.hook: She believes mercy is a discipline that must be defended.

Celsa Sanga.relic: broken execution bell, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Celsa Sanga.hook: She beheads to the beat of the Choir's drums.

Eulalia Clepsina.relic: iron exorcism lantern, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Eulalia Clepsina.hook: She traps spirits in glass lanterns and keeps them as a warning.

Hostilia Galba.relic: broken execution bell, engraved with a tiny ruined sanctuary
Hostilia Galba.hook: She serves a ruined chapel where the dead still queue for judgment.

Fulvia Hemina.relic: covered witchfire brazier, hung from three red wax-sealed chains
Fulvia Hemina.hook: She guards a forbidden testimony hidden inside her bell.

Gaia Vatia.relic: sealed crimson oath vial, framed by a hinged silver protective cover
Gaia Vatia.hook: She swore her blood oath underwater and came up changed.

Crispina Aquila.relic: compact crossbow stock beside shoulder, bearing a cracked oval mother-of-pearl inset
Crispina Aquila.hook: She fletches her bolts with thorns from the Covenant's briar.
